title: 2D art by an agent that you can edit stroke by stroke
author: QuantumWhisker
selftext:
I posted about this yesterday, so sorry in advance if I'm breaking rules... but I don't think that post showed what the tool is and can do very well. 

So here's a gif of the workflow. The basic pitch: your coding agent can use Klad in the ui or headless, to paint and animate any 2D art. It can do painterly, vectors, pixelart...

The best part: any stroke it makes is recorded as data that you can edit afterwards. This makes the whole 2D art workflow much less frustrating to me.

The repo, just point your agent to it: https://github.com/klad-app/klad

Again, mods, sorry if I couldn't post about this again. But I have seen such great results from other gamedevs that I think this is a tool that could benefit the community a lot!

replies.author: QuantumWhisker
replies.body: Glad you like it! If you end up using it, all.feedback is super welcome :)

comments.author: UnfortunateHurricane
comments.body: It looks cool but the question is how much is that in tokens?

replies.author: QuantumWhisker
replies.body: I didn't count, to be honest. That would be a great benchmark. But I'm on a 5x Claude code max and even fable 5.2 drawing a full session with making different illustrations doesn't hit the full context limit. Opus 5.5 can just draw continuously for the entire week and not run out
